clues: Noël Coward wrote Blithe Spirit while staying here in 1941.
The architect Clough Williams-Ellis built it between 1925 and 1975.
It overlooks the Dwyryd estuary, close to Porthmadog.
Its pastel Italianate buildings make it look like a Mediterranean village.
The cult 1960s TV series The Prisoner was filmed in this village in Gwynedd, North Wales.
